mechanics.name: Standard Kill
mechanics.definition: Normal faction or role kill. Protection and immunity interactions depend on the specific card.

mechanics.name: Instant Kill
mechanics.definition: A high-priority kill that bypasses ordinary protections unless a card explicitly stops it.

mechanics.name: Super Kill
mechanics.definition: A stronger kill tier than Instant Kill; only stated counters apply.

mechanics.name: Omega Kill
mechanics.definition: Highest kill tier. It should only be stopped by an explicit Omega counter.

mechanics.name: Poison
mechanics.definition: Applies a lethal delayed condition. Duration, cure rules, and spread are defined by the source ability.

mechanics.name: Bleed
mechanics.definition: Applies continuing or delayed damage according to the source ability.

mechanics.name: Mark
mechanics.definition: Places a tag on a target for later tracking, execution, or ability enhancement.

mechanics.name: Protection
mechanics.definition: Stops one or more harmful effects according to scope and kill-tier limits.

mechanics.name: Bodyguard
mechanics.definition: Redirects harm from the protected target to the bodyguard.

mechanics.name: Roleblock
mechanics.definition: Prevents a player from using an active ability for the affected phase.

mechanics.name: Redirect
mechanics.definition: Changes the target of an ability.

mechanics.name: Target Control
mechanics.definition: The controller chooses the target of another player's ability.

mechanics.name: Silence
mechanics.definition: Restricts a player's ability to communicate.

mechanics.name: Vote Control
mechanics.definition: Removes, changes, hides, or protects voting power.

mechanics.name: Conversion
mechanics.definition: Changes a player's faction or allegiance.

mechanics.name: Basic Ask
mechanics.definition: A limited investigation question using the game's Basic Ask rules.

mechanics.name: Advanced Ask
mechanics.definition: A stronger investigation question using the game's Advanced Ask rules.

mechanics.name: Watcher
mechanics.definition: Learns who visited a selected player.

mechanics.name: Tracker
mechanics.definition: Learns whom a selected player visited or where they moved.

mechanics.name: False Intel
mechanics.definition: Changes, scrambles, or fabricates investigative information.

mechanics.name: Disguise
mechanics.definition: Changes how a player appears to investigations or public information.

mechanics.name: False Death
mechanics.definition: Makes a living player appear dead without applying a real death.

mechanics.name: Delayed Action
mechanics.definition: Moves an action or result to a later phase or Night.

mechanics.name: Linked Fate
mechanics.definition: Connects two or more players so effects or survival conditions are shared.

mechanics.name: World Domination
mechanics.definition: Warner Syndicate progression system that unlocks prototypes and stronger powers.

mechanics.name: Personal Win Condition
mechanics.definition: A Wildcard objective that is evaluated independently from faction victory.

mechanics.name: Warner Den Instant Kill
mechanics.description: One of the Warner Syndicate's two faction-owned den Instant Kills. It does not belong to any Warner player and does not consume a character ability.
